title: Arbiter Grant Starvation — No Timeout on Held Grant
description: Master 0 holds the bus indefinitely while master0_busy is high; without a watchdog timer, master 1 can be starved permanently if master 0 never releases the bus.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] Master 1 not granted for 10000 cycles; master0_busy stuck high
expected_root_cause: The grant logic suppresses the grant to master 0 when master0_busy is high, but there is no watchdog timer to cap how long master 0 can hold the bus; a permanently asserted master0_busy starves master 1 indefinitely.
rtl:
assign gnt = (last_gnt == 1'b0 && master0_busy) ? 1'b0 : last_gnt;
// No timeout — master 1 starved if master0_busy stuck high
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] Master 1 not granted for 10000 cycles; master0_busy stuck high
success_log: force_revoke fires after 201 cycles. Master 1 granted on next arbitration cycle.
